story: The race opened with numerous attacks, and it took some time before a three-rider breakaway was finally established. Foldager’s presence in the move put him in the virtual race lead for a while. The escapees were caught on the final climb, where Gachignard attacked from the peloton. Christophersen responded with an attack of his own, passed Gachignard and continued to the stage victory. Silva finished third on the stage, which was enough for him to win the general classification.
